name: Extra Hengeyokai Shapechanging (Racial)
body:
You can change shape an additional two times per day.

Prerequisite: Hengeyokai

Benefit: You can use your racial shapechanger ability 2 extra times per day.

Special: You can take this feat more than once and each time its effects stack.
